title: Light Fingers
summary: Hob wants five of the Assay guard-captains' passes, lifted off them in the Yards. A rogue of yours will learn something about getting close.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards: put down five of the guard-captains who lead every fifth lot.

ready: Five passes, no questions. Take them to Hob by the well in Ashgate.
done: Hob sold four of the passes back to the Assay. He kept one for you.
